name: Kozel
description: Kozel (the goat), the Soviet courtyard domino game, in a panel to play while Claude works: four players in two pairs with a computer partner and two computer opponents, 28 tiles of a double-six set, first to 101. The 1-1 opens the first round, the chain snakes to fit the panel, a player who goes out scores the opponents' pips and a blocked game (the fish) goes to the lightest hand; a team still at zero when the other reaches 101 is the goat. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
author: BronOS
